title: More on onetary Economics
title_primary: More on onetary Economics
authors: Guido Menzio, Saverio Spinella
official: 官方在线 2026-09-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Does the cashless limit of the monetary equilibrium converge to the non-monetary equilibrium? We revisit the question in the context of Menzio and Spinella (2025), a model in which the financial market where households lend savings and firms borrow capital is subject to frictions. The fraction of households that do not meet any firms determines money demand. The fractions of households that meet one or multiple firms determine the extent of competition, and the sensitivity of real rates to inflation. The cashless limit of the monetary equilibrium converges to the non-monetary equilibrium depending on whether the financial market becomes perfectly competitive, which, in turn, depends on the exact specification of frictions.

title: Housing Market Expectations
title_zh: 住房市场预期
title_primary: 住房市场预期
title_secondary: Housing Market Expectations
authors: Theresa Kuchler, Monika Piazzesi, Johannes Ströbel
official: 官方在线 2022-03-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We review the recent literature on the determinants and effects of housing market expectations. We begin by providing an overview of existing surveys that elicit housing market expectations, and discuss how those surveys may be expanded in the future. We then document a number of facts about time-series and cross-sectional patterns of housing market expectations in these survey data, before summarizing research that has studied how individuals form these expectations. Housing market expectations are strongly influenced by recently observed house price changes, by personally or locally observed house price changes, by house price changes observed in a person's social network, and by current home ownership status. Similarly, experienced house price volatility affects expectations uncertainty. We also summarize recent work that documents how differences in housing market expectations translate into differences in individuals’ housing market behaviors, including their home purchasing and mortgage financing decisions. Finally, we highlight research on how expectations affect aggregate outcomes in the housing market.

title: From LinkedIn to Labor Statistics: Using Revelio Microdata for Labor Market Research in Developing Economies
title_zh: 从领英到劳动统计：利用Revelio微观数据研究发展中经济体的劳动力市场
title_primary: 从领英到劳动统计：利用Revelio微观数据研究发展中经济体的劳动力市场
title_secondary: From LinkedIn to Labor Statistics: Using Revelio Microdata for Labor Market Research in Developing Economies
authors: Samuel Chang, Hans B. Christensen, Ziang Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We explore the use of Revelio data—obtained primarily from LinkedIn profiles—as a source of labor force microdata in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), where large-sample, high-frequency, employer-linked alternatives are largely unavailable. To address the selection inherent to LinkedIn usership, we employ ILO labor statistics to construct five sets of country-year-specific weights that alleviate non-representativeness across occupation, industry, occupation × education, industry × education, and industry × firm-size cells. We further validate these weights using national census data where they are available and not used for ILO labor statistics. The weighted dataset provides a balanced monthly panel with coverage across most LMICs. We also discuss remaining limitations of the dataset, including within-cell selection and self-reporting errors, and suggest techniques to alleviate them. Despite imperfect coverage, Revelio offers improved temporal and geographical resolution as well as cross-country comparability and is especially useful for studying the role of firms in economic development.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了利用Revelio数据——主要源自LinkedIn个人资料——作为低收入和中等收入国家劳动力微观数据来源的可能性，在这些国家，大规模、高频、与雇主关联的替代数据基本不可得。为应对LinkedIn用户群体固有的选择性偏差，我们采用国际劳工组织的劳动统计资料，构建了五组按国家-年份特定的权重，以缓解在职业、行业、职业×教育、行业×教育及行业×企业规模等分类上的非代表性。我们还利用可获取且未用于国际劳工组织统计的国家人口普查数据，对这些权重进行了进一步验证。加权后的数据集提供了一个覆盖大多数低收入和中等收入国家的平衡月度面板。我们还讨论了数据集现存的其他局限，包括单元内选择及自我报告误差，并提出了缓解这些问题的技术方法。尽管覆盖并非完美，Revelio数据在时间与地理分辨率上有所提升，并增强了跨国可比性，尤其适用于研究企业在经济发展中的作用。

title: Exit from performance-based self-employment: evidence from professional boat racers
title_zh: 退出绩效型自雇：来自职业赛艇选手的证据
title_primary: 退出绩效型自雇：来自职业赛艇选手的证据
title_secondary: Exit from performance-based self-employment: evidence from professional boat racers
authors: Nobuya Fukugawa
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines exit from active professional boat racing as a form of exit from performance-based self-employment. Boat racers operate in an individual prize-based labour market in which income opportunities, reputation, and career continuity depend on current performance and periodic institutional evaluation. Drawing on lifecycle models of self-employment and retirement, this study estimates pooled probit models using racer-period panel data from Japan’s professional boat racing industry. Next-period exit is modelled as a function of current performance, accumulated career success, individual characteristics, racing class, and period effects. Current performance is measured by the first-place finish rate in individual races, while accumulated career success is measured by cumulative victories in multi-day race series. The results show that current performance is negatively associated with exit probability, but this exit-deterring association becomes smaller and statistically insignificant among racers with greater accumulated career success. The findings suggest that exit from performance-contingent work depends not only on weaker current performance, but also on how current returns are evaluated relative to accumulated career capital. KEYWORDS: Self-employment exit athlete retirement performance-based self-employment professional labour markets occupational exit JEL CLASSIFICATION: J24 J26 J44 L83 Acknowledgements The author is grateful to the editor and the anonymous referees for their constructive comments.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了退出职业赛艇竞技作为一种退出基于绩效的自雇就业形式的现象。赛艇选手在个人奖金制的劳动力市场中运作，其收入机会、声誉及职业连续性取决于当前表现及定期的机构评估。借鉴自雇与退休的生命周期模型，本研究利用日本职业赛艇行业的选手-时期面板数据，估计了合并概率模型。下一期的退出行为被建模为当前表现、累积职业成就、个人特征、赛艇级别及时期效应的函数。当前表现以个人赛事中的第一名完成率衡量，而累积职业成就则以多日系列赛事中的累计胜利次数衡量。结果显示，当前表现与退出概率呈负相关，但这种退出抑制效应在累积职业成就较高的选手中减弱且统计上不显著。研究结果表明，从绩效依赖型工作中退出不仅取决于当前表现的减弱，还取决于当前回报相对于累积职业资本的评估方式。关键词：自雇退出 运动员退休 基于绩效的自雇 专业劳动力市场 职业退出 JEL分类：J24 J26 J44 L83 致谢 作者感谢编辑及匿名审稿人的建设性意见。

title: Beyond the “supply chain” framing: Cattle ranching as a vanishing mediator of deforestation and dispossession in the Brazilian and Colombian Amazon
title_zh: 超越“供应链”框架：养牛业作为巴西亚马孙与哥伦比亚亚马孙地区森林砍伐和土地掠夺的消逝中介
title_primary: 超越“供应链”框架：养牛业作为巴西亚马孙与哥伦比亚亚马孙地区森林砍伐和土地掠夺的消逝中介
title_secondary: Beyond the “supply chain” framing: Cattle ranching as a vanishing mediator of deforestation and dispossession in the Brazilian and Colombian Amazon
authors: Mairon G. Bastos Lima, Jesica López
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Unsustainable land-use change has become an increasingly critical social and environmental issue. Over a few decades, vast expanses of land with native vegetation or devoted to mixed-farming systems have given way to large-scale agriculture, incurring considerable biodiversity and livelihood loss. Cattle ranching and the production of a handful of internationally traded commodities such as soy and palm oil play a pivotal role in that expansion. They have led to numerous sustainability initiatives to curb their negative social and environmental impacts, yet a “supply chain” framing poses important limitations, for it typically fails to consider relationships between sectors and broader landscape dynamics. For one, there may be much stronger drivers than food consumption at play. This article draws from the frontier literature and explores the concept of “vanishing mediator” to analyze the role played by cattle ranching in particular. Comparing the Brazilian and Colombian Amazon, we assess how ranching intermediates an ongoing transition between pre-frontier forest areas and capital-intensive monocultures. We draw from land-use data and the scientific literature on each of the two cases as well as on a total of 30 key-informant interviews done in Brazil and Colombia. Our results show that cattle ranching’s role in spearheading deforestation in both countries cannot be understood without reference to its broader context, for it works as a vanishing mediator between pre-frontier settings and industrial agriculture. Ranching occupies frontiers with little infrastructure, paving the way for monocultures; it is instrumental to the land grabbing that makes the endeavor highly profitable; and, crucially, it precariously absorbs and co-opts displaced smallholders. Cattle ranching introduces the latter — as well as incoming settlers — to state institutions that previously neglected them and to a market-driven approach to land use that still preserves the trappings of rural living. Ultimately, however, people migrate to sprawling cities and clear the way for capital-intensive crops such as soy in Brazil and oil palm in Colombia. We conclude that the notion of individualized “supply chains” is shortsighted for dealing with such broader dynamics. Instead, effective sustainability interventions require addressing local vulnerabilities and investing in economic alternatives that can successfully hedge against deforestation drivers.
abstract_zh: 不可持续的土地利用变化已成为日益严峻的社会与环境问题。数十年来，大片原生植被覆盖或用于混合农业系统的土地被大规模农业所取代，造成了显著的生物多样性丧失和生计损失。养牛业以及大豆、棕榈油等少数国际贸易商品的生产在这一扩张中扮演了关键角色。这些活动催生了众多旨在遏制其负面社会与环境影响的可持续性倡议，然而，“供应链”框架存在重大局限，因为它通常未能考虑部门之间的关系及更广泛的景观动态。例如，可能存在着比食品消费更为强大的驱动因素。本文借鉴前沿文献，探讨“消逝的中介”这一概念，以分析养牛业所扮演的特殊角色。通过比较巴西亚马孙与哥伦比亚亚马孙，我们评估了养牛业如何在前沿森林地区与资本密集型单一作物种植之间的持续转型中发挥中介作用。我们利用土地利用数据、针对这两个案例的科学研究文献，以及在巴西和哥伦比亚进行的共30次关键知情人访谈。研究结果表明，若不参照更广泛的背景，就无法理解养牛业在两国带头推动毁林中的作用，因为它在前沿地带与工业化农业之间充当着消逝的中介。养牛业占据基础设施匮乏的前沿地区，为单一作物种植铺平道路；它有助于土地掠夺，使这一活动高度有利可图；并且至关重要的是，它不稳定地吸纳并同化了被边缘化的小农。养牛业将后者——以及新来的定居者——引入此前忽视他们的国家机构，并引入一种仍保留乡村生活表象的市场导向型土地利用方式。然而，最终人们迁往不断扩张的城市，为巴西的大豆和哥伦比亚的油棕等资本密集型作物让路。我们得出结论，个体化“供应链”的概念在处理此类更广泛的动态时是短视的。相反，有效的可持续性干预措施需要解决地方脆弱性问题，并投资于能够成功对冲毁林驱动因素的经济替代方案。

title: Countercyclical policy bank loans and economic stability: evidence from China’s listed firms
title_zh: 逆周期政策性银行贷款与经济稳定：来自中国上市公司的证据
title_primary: 逆周期政策性银行贷款与经济稳定：来自中国上市公司的证据
title_secondary: Countercyclical policy bank loans and economic stability: evidence from China’s listed firms
authors: Jian Xiong, Wei Yin, Guangzi Li, Peng Zhou
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the underexplored role of China’s policy bank loans as a countercyclical tool for stabilizing economic fluctuations, complementing conventional fiscal and monetary policies. Utilizing panel data on Chinese listed companies from 2005 to 2023, we demonstrate that policy bank loans effectively mitigate the adverse impacts of economic downturns, and ensure corporate value stability during periods of contraction. The research further identifies that the countercyclical effect of these loans is influenced by both internal factors, including political and economic stability and tax revenue growth, as well as external factors such as global financial uncertainty. Additionally, the study highlights the complementary role of policy bank loans alongside conventional stabilization measures, strengthening the combined capacity to enhance macroeconomic stability. KEYWORDS: Policy banks countercyclical listed firms economic stability JEL CLASSIFICATION: G21 G32
abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国政策性银行贷款作为稳定经济波动的逆周期工具这一尚未充分研究的角色，其与常规财政和货币政策形成互补。利用2005年至2023年中国上市公司的面板数据，我们证明政策性银行贷款能够有效缓解经济下行带来的不利影响，并在经济收缩期间保障企业价值稳定。研究进一步识别出，这些贷款的逆周期效应受到内部因素（包括政治与经济稳定性及税收增长）和外部因素（如全球金融不确定性）的共同影响。此外，研究强调了政策性银行贷款与常规稳定措施之间的互补作用，增强了共同提升宏观经济稳定的能力。关键词：政策性银行 逆周期 上市公司 经济稳定 JEL分类：G21 G32

title: E-ledgers Carbon Accounting
title_zh: 电子账簿碳核算
title_primary: 电子账簿碳核算
title_secondary: E-ledgers Carbon Accounting
authors: Robert S. Kaplan, Karthik Ramanna
official: 官方在线 2026-08-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In prior publications, we introduced a global system of interconnected E-ledgers that produces—in as close to real time as practicable—accurate, comparable, and verifiable accounts of the cradle-to-gate (net) greenhouse gas emissions in any product or service that transacts in the economy. In this paper, we delve more deeply into the accounting infrastructure required for the E-ledgers system, including the specific journal entries for recording E-liabilities and E-assets. We explain how the E-ledgers of different entities in the economy articulate with each other and how they connect with jurisdictional E-ledgers that record emissions from end consumers. These entity and jurisdictional E-ledgers can be aggregated into a geological master ledger that tracks anthropogenic GHG emissions and removals, as debits and credits, to a geological carbon equity account. We also provide summary insights from computational technology and pilot studies to guide rapid and cost-effective E-ledgers deployment at scale. This paper was accepted by Shiva Rajgopal, accounting. Funding: Funding for R. S. Kaplan’s research was provided by Harvard Business School. K. Ramanna receives a salary from Oxford University. The authors are co-founders of E-ledgers Institute, a nonprofit organization, which seeks to implement the E-ledgers carbon accounting method in practice.

title: The Human Factor in Logistics: Physiological and Psychological Insights Regarding Truck Drivers
title_zh: 物流中的人为因素：关于卡车司机生理与心理的洞察
title_primary: 物流中的人为因素：关于卡车司机生理与心理的洞察
title_secondary: The Human Factor in Logistics: Physiological and Psychological Insights Regarding Truck Drivers
authors: Keil, Maria
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The logistics industry, as well as various trade and industrial sectors, are facing the challenge of dealing with an economically significant shortage of truck drivers. Currently, approximately 7% of truck driver positions in Germany and Europe are vacant (IRU 2024). At the same time, statistics show an increase in transport performance in ton-kilometers and a shift towards vehicles in higher weight classes (DLR 2023). The age structure is a key aspect that could contribute to this shortage of truck drivers, particularly in a long-term perspective. In Germany, the proportion of truck drivers aged 55 or older is 36%, while at the European level this is 33%. In contrast, the proportion of truck drivers aged 25 or younger in Germany and Europe is only 3% and 5%, respectively (IRU 2024). This difference points to future challenges in human resources management for logistics: A significant proportion of truck drivers will retire due to age, but a corresponding increase in the number of younger truck drivers cannot be expected. Furthermore, truck drivers are exposed to a high daily workload. Hege et al. 2019 as well as Hill and Boyle 2007 demonstrate that an analysis is necessary to promote the occupational health and safety of this specific group, strengthen their intrinsic motivation, and enhance their performance. Truck drivers are exposed to various hazards. An empirical study showed that insomnia, a stress-induced reduction in attention, and the resulting irritability are significant risk factors for traffic accidents (Shams et al. 2021). Therefore, a promising area of research is dedicated to the well-being of truck drivers and employees. According to relevant research, employee well-being has a significant impact on work efficiency in general (Corbett 2024) and road safety specifically. To gain deeper scientific insights into this area, an interdisciplinary approach is necessary. Interdisciplinary research challenges disciplinary boundaries and exclusive focuses and offers new perspectives for understanding complex phenomena that cannot be fully grasped by a single discipline alone. Expanding disciplinary perspectives to include complex empirical questions is necessary to investigate real-world situations, gain new insights, and develop problem-oriented solutions. Challenges such as cross-disciplinary motivation, the development of a common language, the formulation of shared theories, and the creation of practical applications must be overcome. If these hurdles are overcome, interdisciplinary research can significantly contribute to a better understanding of complex management phenomena. Not only does it support a holistic perspective on theoretical questions, it also enables the development of novel methodological approaches. Collaboration between different disciplines is crucial for expanding scientific knowledge and developing practice-relevant solutions to current management challenges (Reinecke et al. 2024). This dissertation highlights the need for research in this field and addresses complex issues related to it. Due to this complexity, interdisciplinary approaches were chosen. The study addresses the relevance of personnel heterogeneity and individual resources for job performance, as well as the previously under-researched relationships between truck driver characteristics and their performance and safety. A synchronized data collection approach for truck drivers, which considers individual characteristics and their impact on health, performance, and safety, is presented below. Practical applications in human resource management and distribution are outlined. Finally, the underlying theories and methodological approaches are explained. The human factor is the central research topic in each of the individual complexes of this dissertation. This provides the relevant framework and highlights the shift from the Industry 4.0 concept with a technological focus to the "Industry 5.0" paradigm with a complementary human-centric approach. The aim is to analyze the effects of human factors and utilize them in operational areas for the productive design of work processes, thereby jointly improving work quality in terms of health and productivity. In this sense, this dissertation offers insights into future human-centric logistics management concepts.
abstract_zh: 物流业以及各类贸易和工业部门正面临应对经济上显著的卡车司机短缺问题的挑战。目前，德国和欧洲约有7%的卡车司机职位空缺（IRU 2024）。与此同时，统计数据显示，以吨公里计的运输绩效有所提升，并且车辆向更高重量级别转移（DLR 2023）。年龄结构是可能加剧卡车司机短缺的关键因素，尤其是在长期视角下。在德国，55岁及以上卡车司机的比例为36%，而在欧洲层面这一比例为33%。相比之下，德国和欧洲25岁及以下卡车司机的比例分别仅为3%和5%（IRU 2024）。这一差异预示着物流业人力资源管理未来面临的挑战：相当大比例的卡车司机将因年龄原因退休，但无法预期年轻卡车司机数量会有相应的增长。此外，卡车司机承受着高强度的日常工作负荷。Hege等人2019年以及Hill和Boyle 2007年的研究表明，有必要进行分析，以促进这一特定群体的职业健康与安全，增强其内在动机，并提升其绩效。卡车司机面临多种危害。一项实证研究表明，失眠、压力引起的注意力下降以及由此产生的易怒情绪是交通事故的重要风险因素（Shams等人2021）。因此，一个具有前景的研究领域致力于卡车司机和员工的福祉。根据相关研究，员工福祉总体上对工作效率（Corbett 2024）以及具体到道路安全具有显著影响。为了在该领域获得更深入的科学见解，需要采用跨学科方法。跨学科研究挑战学科边界和单一关注点，为理解单一学科无法完全把握的复杂现象提供了新视角。扩展学科视角以涵盖复杂的实证问题，对于调查现实情境、获取新见解和制定问题导向的解决方案是必要的。必须克服跨学科动机、共同语言的发展、共享理论的构建以及实际应用的创造等挑战。如果这些障碍得以克服，跨学科研究可以显著促进对复杂管理现象的更好理解。它不仅支持对理论问题的整体视角，还使得新颖方法论方法的开发成为可能。不同学科之间的合作对于扩展科学知识和制定应对当前管理挑战的实践相关解决方案至关重要（Reinecke等人2024）。本论文强调了该领域的研究需求，并处理了与之相关的复杂问题。由于这种复杂性，选择了跨学科方法。研究涉及人员异质性和个体资源对工作绩效的相关性，以及此前研究不足的卡车司机特征与其绩效和安全之间的关系。下文提出了一种同步数据收集方法，用于卡车司机，考虑个体特征及其对健康、绩效和安全的影响。概述了人力资源管理和配送中的实际应用。最后，解释了基础理论和方法论方法。人的因素是本论文各个独立研究模块中的核心研究主题。这提供了相关框架，并突出了从以技术为中心的工业4.0概念向以互补性人本方法为特征的“工业5.0”范式的转变。目标是分析人的因素的影响，并在运营领域利用这些因素来生产性地设计工作流程，从而在健康和生产效率方面共同改善工作质量。在这个意义上，本论文为未来以人为中心的物流管理概念提供了见解。

abstract: This paper tests if bureaucratic leadership impacts the quality of service provision of a difficult-to-monitor task: learning in public schools. Using the empirical case of rural India, it exploits an administrative setup with two types of bureaucrats for the same spatial unit, the district, that either have more authority or more ability to engage in time-intensive persuasion. Utilizing blocked randomization inference and bias-corrected variance decomposition on bureaucratic postings linked to independent learning data from household surveys across 10 years, it shows that only those bureaucrats with less authority but more ability to engage in persuasion impact learning. Drawing on novel interview data, it illustrates how bureaucratic leaders can increase effort levels of subordinates through persuasion to overcome collective action problems rather than relying on orders and monitoring as principal-agent frameworks would suggest. The findings illustrate that for difficult-to-monitor tasks managerial intensity and persistence trump formal authority.
abstract_zh: 本文检验了官僚领导力是否影响难以监督的任务——公立学校学习——的服务质量。以印度农村为实证案例，利用同一空间单元（即地区）设有两类官僚的行政架构，其中一类拥有更多权威，另一类则更擅长投入时间进行说服。通过采用区组随机化推断和偏差校正方差分解，结合十年间家庭调查中独立的學習数据与官僚任职信息，研究表明，只有那些权威较少但更擅长说服的官僚才能对学习产生影响。借助新颖的访谈数据，本文阐述了官僚领导者如何通过说服提升下属的努力水平，以克服集体行动问题，而非依赖命令和监督，这与委托-代理框架的预期不同。研究结果表明，对于难以监督的任务，管理强度与坚持胜过正式权威。

abstract: Henry Kissinger wrote that ‘The more moderate the objective, the less violent war is likely to be’, as if the choice of weapons and the manner of their use would be governed by the war-aims of the contestants. Yet the choice of means had to be decided on the basis of those available, and the problem faced by the proponents of limited war was that the means most appropriate for limited objectives—strong, local conventional forces—were by far the most expensive. However strong the argument for conventional forces in terms of military logic, it would not carry the day if there were no funds available from hard-pressed and restricted national budgets (paradoxically, limited budgets did not make for limited war). In consequence many, but not all, of the proponents of limited war in the mid-1950s opted for ‘tactical’ nuclear weapons.
abstract_zh: 亨利·基辛格曾写道：“目标越有限，战争可能就越不激烈”，仿佛武器的选择及其使用方式将由参战方的战争目标所决定。然而，手段的选择必须基于现有条件来决定，而有限战争的支持者所面临的问题是，最适合有限目标的手段——强大的地方常规部队——恰恰是最昂贵的。无论从军事逻辑角度看常规部队的论点多么有力，如果资金不足，受困于紧张且受限的国家预算（矛盾的是，有限的预算并未促成有限战争），这一论点也难以胜出。因此，在1950年代中期，许多——尽管并非全部——有限战争的支持者转而选择了“战术”核武器。

abstract: This paper constructs a new annual panel for 14 Western countries over 1800–2016, linking homicide to alcohol consumption (by beverage type), drug offenses, deterrence, and education. The central innovation is the first harmonized long-run cross-country alcohol series that can be aligned with the major historical waves in lethal violence. Across graphical evidence, narratives, and multivariate panel regressions, homicide co-moves strongly with alcohol, while education, deterrence, and demography capture the broader institutional context. We interpret the estimates as suggestive long-run relationships and use them for a multivariate historical accounting of the post-war crime wave and subsequent decline.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个覆盖14个西方国家、时间跨度为1800年至2016年的新型年度面板数据，将凶杀案与酒精消费（按饮料类型）、毒品犯罪、威慑力量及教育水平联系起来。核心创新在于首次建立了与致命暴力主要历史浪潮相吻合的、协调一致的长期跨国酒精消费序列。通过图形证据、叙事分析和多元面板回归，凶杀案与酒精消费呈现强相关性，而教育、威慑及人口结构则捕捉了更广泛的制度背景。我们将这些估计解读为提示性的长期关系，并利用它们对战后犯罪浪潮及其后续下降进行多元历史核算。

abstract: Based on panel data from 2011 to 2022 covering all Chinese provinces except Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and Tibet, this study constructs a multi-weighted, multi-scenario spatial Durbin model to examine the structural stability of the relationship between agricultural industrial agglomeration and rural labour outflow. The results indicate that the local effect of agricultural industrial agglomeration on labour outflow is not a structurally stable relationship, but rather an average effect dependent on specific contextual conditions. Spatial spillover effects are generally limited and lack robustness, thereby refuting the implicit assumption in existing research that ‘agglomeration effects possess cross-spatial stability’. These spillover effects exhibit directional consistency only under specific spatial linkages and institutional conditions, suggesting that they are closer to a context-triggered latent mechanism. The moderating role of contextual variables indicates that this effect is not universally present but is embedded within specific spatial structures, thereby revealing that it is essentially a conditional process dependent on spatial structure. Based on these findings, this paper defines the scope of agricultural agglomeration effects from the perspective of spatial structure and institutional conditions, revealing that these effects hold only under specific forms of connectivity and contextual conditions. abstract_zh: 基于2011至2022年间中国除香港、澳门、台湾及西藏外所有省份的面板数据，本研究构建了一个多权重、多情景的空间杜宾模型，旨在考察农业产业集聚与农村劳动力外流之间关系的结构稳定性。研究结果显示，农业产业集聚对劳动力外流的本地效应并非一种结构稳定的关系，而是一种依赖于特定情境条件的平均效应。空间溢出效应总体有限且缺乏稳健性，从而反驳了现有研究中隐含的“集聚效应具有跨空间稳定性”的假设。这些溢出效应仅在特定的空间联系和制度条件下表现出方向一致性，表明它们更接近于一种由情境触发的潜在机制。情境变量的调节作用表明，这一效应并非普遍存在，而是嵌入于特定的空间结构之中，从而揭示其本质上是一个依赖于空间结构的条件过程。基于上述发现，本文从空间结构与制度条件的视角界定了农业集聚效应的适用范围，揭示这些效应仅在特定的连接形式与情境条件下成立。关键词：农业产业集聚；农村劳动力外流；空间杜宾模型；空间溢出；JEL分类：Q18；O15

abstract: We empirically examine the role of both official monetary policy announcements and policymakers' speeches in the transmission of monetary policy to financial markets and the real economy in the euro area. Using intraday data covering a broad cross-section of financial assets, we construct the Euro Area Extended Monetary Policy Event-Study Database (EA-EMPD). We refine the identification of monetary policy surprises by exploiting granular, quote-level data on individual participants' bid and ask submissions. This novel dataset expands the set of identifiable policy events by an order of magnitude relative to databases based solely on scheduled rate-setting meetings. Our analysis yields three main findings. First, speeches by euro area policymakers exert statistically and economically significant effects on asset prices across maturities, with magnitudes comparable to those observed following official policy announcements. Second, the transmission of speech-induced short-rate changes to the real economy closely mirrors that of policy decisions and combining both types of surprises significantly enhances the precision of statistical inference. Finally, when speeches are included in the measurement of policy surprises, the share of real-economy variance attributable to monetary policy increases fivefold, although its absolute magnitude remains relatively modest.
abstract_zh: 我们实证考察了官方货币政策公告与政策制定者演讲在欧元区货币政策向金融市场及实体经济传导中的作用。利用覆盖广泛金融资产的日内数据，我们构建了欧元区扩展货币政策事件研究数据库（EA-EMPD）。通过利用个体参与者买卖报价的细粒度报价级数据，我们优化了货币政策冲击的识别方法。这一新颖数据集将可识别政策事件的范围相较于仅基于预定利率设定会议的数据库扩大了一个数量级。我们的分析得出三项主要发现。首先，欧元区政策制定者的演讲对各期限资产价格产生了统计上和经济上显著的影响，其幅度与官方政策公告后观察到的效应相当。其次，演讲引发的短期利率变化向实体经济的传导与政策决策的传导路径高度相似，且将两类冲击结合使用能显著提升统计推断的精确度。最后，当演讲被纳入政策冲击的衡量时，货币政策可解释的实体经济方差份额增加了五倍，尽管其绝对规模仍相对有限。

abstract: We estimate the causal effects of macroprudential policies on the entire distribution of GDP growth for advanced European economies using a narrative‐identification strategy in a quantile‐regression framework. While macroprudential policy has near‐zero effects on the center of the GDP‐growth distribution, tighter policy brings benefits by reducing the variance of future growth, significantly boosting the left tail while simultaneously reducing the right. Assessing a range of channels through which these effects materialize, we find that macroprudential policy particularly operates through ‘credit‐at‐risk’: it reduces the right tail of future credit growth, dampening booms, in turn reducing the likelihood of extreme GDP‐growth outturns.
abstract_zh: 我们采用叙事识别策略，在分位数回归框架下，估算了宏观审慎政策对欧洲发达经济体GDP增长整体分布的因果效应。尽管宏观审慎政策对GDP增长分布的中心几乎无影响，但收紧政策通过降低未来增长的方差带来益处，显著提升左尾的同时削减右尾。通过评估这些效应得以显现的多种渠道，我们发现宏观审慎政策尤其通过“风险信贷”发挥作用：它减少了未来信贷增长的右尾，抑制了繁荣，进而降低了极端GDP增长结果的可能性。

abstract: Intermediary asset pricing posits that financial institutions play a central role in financial markets, and that their decisions shape asset prices beyond simply reflecting the preferences of the average household. This perspective helps make sense of key empirical patterns: the excess volatility of asset prices, differences in price movements across asset classes, the cross-section of expected returns within asset classes, and specific arbitrage opportunities and price dislocations. We also review the implications of intermediary asset pricing for macroeconomic dynamics, international economics, and policy. In this approach, a primary channel of financial regulation and monetary policy is through alleviating constraints or removing risk from intermediary balance sheets during periods of stress. We highlight both existing progress and gaps for future research.
abstract_zh: 中介资产定价理论认为，金融机构在金融市场中扮演核心角色，其决策不仅反映普通家庭的平均偏好，更直接塑造资产价格。这一视角有助于解释关键实证现象：资产价格的过度波动、不同资产类别间的价格差异、同类资产预期收益率的截面特征，以及特定套利机会与价格错位。本文还梳理了中介资产定价对宏观经济动态、国际经济学及政策制定的启示。在该理论框架下，金融监管与货币政策的主要传导渠道，是在压力时期缓解中介机构面临的约束或消除其资产负债表风险。我们既总结了现有研究进展，也指出了未来需要填补的空白。

abstract: When a new technology promises large private benefits but may impose social costs that markets do not price, demand need not reveal how citizens want it governed. We examine this using a nationally representative U.S. survey experiment (N=5,556) on human enhancement technologies (HET). The experiment randomizes benefit domain, mechanism, heritability, purpose, and risk across vignettes; for each respondent’s assigned vignette, we elicit stated adoption, preferred regulation, and ethical and societal concerns. Overall, about 53% would adopt. Framing the technology as enhancing rather than restorative lowers adoption by about five percentage points, as much as a severe side-effect profile. About 28% would not adopt at any benefit. This refusal is driven overwhelmingly by the enhancing framing rather than by risk, consistent with a non-compensatory constraint for a substantial subgroup. Most who would adopt still favor strict regulation, and most who would never adopt do not wish to forbid others from doing so. Productivity enhancement generates the most ethical concern of any attribute but attracts the least regulation, and respondents favor subsidizing rather than taxing its adoption, consistent with a concern about access rather than safety. Private demand is therefore an unreliable guide to the governance citizens want, and the divergence we document provides a basis for regulators seeking to align the direction of technical change with societal values and priorities.
abstract_zh: 当一项新技术承诺带来巨大私人收益，却可能施加市场无法定价的社会成本时，需求未必能揭示公民希望如何对其进行治理。我们通过一项针对人类增强技术（HET）的全美代表性调查实验（N=5,556）对此展开研究。该实验随机分配了情境描述中的收益领域、作用机制、可遗传性、目的和风险；针对每位受访者分配的情境描述，我们收集了其声称的采纳意愿、偏好监管方式以及伦理与社会关切。总体而言，约53%的受访者表示会采纳。将技术描述为"增强型"而非"恢复型"会使采纳率降低约五个百分点，其影响程度与严重副作用特征相当。约28%的受访者在任何收益条件下均不会采纳。这种拒绝行为主要由"增强型"框架而非风险驱动，这与相当一部分子群体的非补偿性约束特征一致。大多数愿意采纳者仍支持严格监管，而大多数永不采纳者并不希望禁止他人使用。在各项属性中，生产力增强引发的伦理关切最为强烈，但受到的监管最少；受访者倾向于补贴而非征税来促进其采纳，这与对可及性而非安全性的关切相符。因此，私人需求无法可靠反映公民期望的治理方式，我们记录的这种分歧为监管者提供了依据，以引导技术变革方向与社会价值观和优先事项保持一致。

title: Who Marries Whom? The Role of Segregation by Race and Class
title_zh: 谁与谁结婚？种族与阶级隔离的作用
title_primary: 谁与谁结婚？种族与阶级隔离的作用
title_secondary: Who Marries Whom? The Role of Segregation by Race and Class
authors: Goldman, Benjamin, Gracie, Jamie, Porter, Sonya R.
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Americans rarely marry outside their race or class group, a pattern with well-documented implications for inequality and intergenerational mobility. Limited exposure may partly explain these low intergroup marriage rates. We instrument for exposure using variation in childhood neighborhoods based on whether other race and class groups had more opposite-sex children of similar age. Exposure increases interclass (high- and low-parent-income) marriage but has no detectable effect on interracial (White and Black) marriage. A spatial marriage model predicts that residential segregation—one of many forms of exposure—accounts for more than one third of marital sorting by class but less than 5 percent by race.
abstract_zh: 美国人很少跨种族或跨阶层通婚，这一模式对不平等和代际流动性具有充分论证的影响。有限的接触机会可能部分解释了这些低群体间通婚率。我们利用童年居住社区的差异——基于其他种族和阶层群体中是否有更多同龄异性儿童——作为接触机会的工具变量。接触机会增加了跨阶层（高收入与低收入父母家庭）通婚，但对跨种族（白人与黑人）通婚未产生可检测的影响。空间婚姻模型预测，居住隔离（接触机会的多种形式之一）解释了超过三分之一的阶层婚姻匹配，但仅解释了不到5%的种族婚姻匹配。

title: Uncertainty and Change: Survey Evidence of Firms’ Subjective Beliefs
title_zh: 不确定性与变化：企业主观信念的调查证据
title_primary: 不确定性与变化：企业主观信念的调查证据
title_secondary: Uncertainty and Change: Survey Evidence of Firms’ Subjective Beliefs
authors: Bachmann, Rüdiger, Carstensen, Kai, Lautenbacher, Stefan, Menkhoff, Manuel, Schneider, Martin
official: 卷期日期 2026-08-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies how managers plan under uncertainty. In a new panel survey of German manufacturing firms, we observe both forecasts of sales growth and a quantitative measure of subjective uncertainty. We show that subjective uncertainty reflects change experienced by firms: it is high when growth is either unusually low or unusually high. Subjective uncertainty is more than conditional volatility: while more volatile firms are typically more uncertain, experienced change alone increases uncertainty, consistent with a model of learning. Uncertainty over our sample is mostly idiosyncratic but varies substantially over time and leads managers to plan lower employment and prices.
abstract_zh: 本文研究管理者如何在不确定性下进行规划。基于一项针对德国制造业企业的新面板调查，我们同时观测到销售增长预测与主观不确定性的量化指标。研究表明，主观不确定性反映了企业经历的变化：当增长率异常低或异常高时，不确定性均会上升。主观不确定性不仅体现为条件波动性：尽管波动性较高的企业通常面临更大不确定性，但仅凭经历的变化本身就会加剧不确定性，这与学习模型的理论预测一致。样本期间的不确定性主要呈现异质性特征，但随时间显著波动，并促使管理者制定更低的就业与价格计划。

title: Symmetric Equilibrium in Pre-Auction Investment
title_zh: 拍卖前投资中的对称均衡
title_primary: 拍卖前投资中的对称均衡
title_secondary: Symmetric Equilibrium in Pre-Auction Investment
authors: Quint, Daniel, Kojima, Fuhito
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We characterize the symmetric equilibria of a pre-auction game of investment in an internet ad auction environment. For a wide class of auction formats, we show a symmetric equilibrium exists for the pre-auction investment game, is essentially unique, and is the same for all auction formats in the class; we give sufficient conditions for the symmetric equilibrium to be in pure strategies, and to achieve the efficient level of investment. Finally, we show comparative statics results with respect to a variety of parameters.
abstract_zh: 本文刻画了互联网广告拍卖环境中投资前博弈的对称均衡特征。对于一大类拍卖形式，我们证明投资前博弈存在对称均衡，该均衡本质唯一，且对该类所有拍卖形式均相同；我们给出了对称均衡为纯策略均衡并实现有效投资水平的充分条件。最后，我们展示了关于多种参数的比较静态分析结果。

title: 央企共链行动何以推动技术双向进化？——以“九天”基座大模型为例

official: 官方发布 2026-07-05 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: 央企共链行动旨在打破跨产业领域合作壁垒，推动链长企业间融通创新。然而，作为一种外源性制度安排，其如何在合作双方缺乏历史互动与领域重叠的条件下重构企业间依赖关系，进而催生技术双向进化，仍有待探索。针对此问题，以中国移动“九天”基座大模型跨产业链赋能的共链实践为案例，结合制度理论与组织共演理论展开剖析。本文研究发现，共链行动的核心作用在于通过注入制度信任，以破解市场机制下难以自发形成的跨链协作信任困境。其传导路径在于：一是在制度层面，共链行动通过塑造链长身份与共链过程的合法性形成制度信任，构成协作初始信任的关键前因；二是在组织层面，桥接性议题场域充当关键过程机制，将抽象的制度信任转化为具体的组织协同；三是在技术层面，技术要素的跨领域编排催生技术依赖关系，从而激活供需双方技术渗透与要素反哺的价值共创循环，构成技术双向进化的核心生成机制。研究结论涌现为制度型技术共生模型，阐明了外源性的制度安排如何通过破解信任困境，最终催化出一个内生、自持的技术共演机制。

title: Diversity taxes: Linking identity expression, social contact, and taxation
title_zh: 多样性税：身份表达、社会接触与税收的关联
title_primary: 多样性税：身份表达、社会接触与税收的关联
title_secondary: Diversity taxes: Linking identity expression, social contact, and taxation
authors: Saumya Deojain, David Lindequist
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The sociological literature suggests that within diverse communities, individuals create externalities on members of other social groups when they express identity through the consumption of market goods. Positive identity expression externalities lead individuals to increase their exposure to out-group identity expression, while negative externalities lead them to reduce it. At the same time, to the extent that identity expression is tied to market consumption, fiscal policy can influence how much identity is expressed by affecting individuals’ disposable income. We develop a theoretical framework in which identity expression externalities are addressed through these two channels: individuals privately adjust their social contacts to manage exposure, while local governments can use taxation to influence the visibility of identity in shared spaces. We study how these mechanisms interact, and how policy depends on which social group the government prioritizes and whether individuals react favorably or unfavorably to out-group expression. We find that governments amplify the behavioral response to diversity by adjusting the intensity of identity signaling through tax policy. We also show that greater openness to diversity can reduce demand for taxation, leading to more visible identity expression but also more private avoidance. The framework can accommodate a range of political-economy, fiscal, and institutional extensions.
abstract_zh: 社会学文献表明，在多元化的社区中，个体通过消费市场商品来表达身份时，会对其他社会群体的成员产生外部性。积极的身份表达外部性促使个体增加对外群体身份表达的接触，而消极的外部性则促使他们减少这种接触。同时，由于身份表达与市场消费紧密相关，财政政策可以通过影响个体的可支配收入来调节身份表达的程度。我们构建了一个理论框架，其中身份表达外部性通过两条渠道得以解决：个体私下调整其社会交往以管理接触，而地方政府则可以利用税收来影响共享空间中身份的可见性。我们研究了这些机制如何相互作用，以及政策如何取决于政府优先考虑哪个社会群体，以及个体对外群体表达是持积极还是消极反应。我们发现，政府通过税收政策调整身份信号的强度，从而放大对多样性的行为反应。我们还表明，对多样性更大的开放性可能减少对税收的需求，导致身份表达更加可见，但同时也增加了私下的回避行为。该框架能够容纳一系列政治经济学、财政和制度方面的扩展。

title: International trade finance and learning dynamics

title_primary: 国际贸易融资与学习动态
title_secondary: International trade finance and learning dynamics
authors: David Kohn, Emiliano Luttini, Michal Szkup, Shengxing Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study how relationship-specific learning affects the joint dynamics of exports and trade finance. Using micro-level Chilean data, we document that new exporters initially rely on cash-in-advance payments and gradually transition to providing trade credit as relationships mature, with faster transitions in riskier destinations and for less experienced firms. Motivated by this, we develop a general equilibrium trade model that integrates learning about foreign demand and counterparty risk together with firms’ endogenous export and trade finance choices. We use the model to investigate the role of learning and risks in shaping export adjustments and quantify the impact of shocks to the cost of trade finance on aggregate exports. We find that the response to these shocks depends on the riskiness of the destination and is amplified by the disruption of long-term trading relationships.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了关系特定性学习如何影响出口与贸易融资的联合动态。利用智利微观层面数据，我们记录了新出口商最初依赖预付现金支付，并随着关系成熟逐步转向提供贸易信贷，且在风险更高的目的地和缺乏经验的企业中，这一转变速度更快。受此启发，我们构建了一个一般均衡贸易模型，该模型整合了对外国需求和交易对手风险的学习，以及企业内生性的出口和贸易融资选择。我们利用该模型探讨学习与风险在塑造出口调整中的作用，并量化贸易融资成本冲击对总体出口的影响。我们发现，对这些冲击的响应取决于目的地的风险程度，并因长期贸易关系的破裂而被放大。

title: Cost and affordability of recommended diets in Rwanda using [near] real-time market data
title_zh: 使用[近]实时市场数据的卢旺达推荐膳食成本与可负担性
title_primary: 使用[近]实时市场数据的卢旺达推荐膳食成本与可负担性
title_secondary: Cost and affordability of recommended diets in Rwanda using [near] real-time market data
authors: Rhys Manners, Kate Schneider Lecy, James Warner, Eric Matsiko, Hilda Vasanthakaalam 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Countries are increasingly benchmarking food assistance and labour laws on the cost of nationally recommended diets. Benchmarking is made against national annual estimates, which fail to account for sub-national and intra-annual variation in cost, blunting the impact of policies. Using monthly market price data collected by the Government of Rwanda (April 2019-March 2024), we estimate the cost of the country’s proposed food-based dietary guidelines, using a standardised diet costing methodology. We found rural areas experienced greater inflation in diet cost over the study period than urban areas (41% vs 28%), yet the recommended diet was 12.7% higher in urban locations. Diet costs were approximately 6% lower in districts with international border crossings to Tanzania, but 7% more in those with borders with the Democratic Republic of Congo. Fruits and vegetables (110% and 71%) and starchy staples (86% and 83%) contributed most to cost increases in rural and urban locations respectively. Seasonal diet cost fluctuations were also evident with a seasonal amplitude of 5.6% and 6.9% in rural and urban locations, synchronised to Rwanda’s agricultural calendar. 70% of employed Rwandans would find the recommended diet unaffordable, if spending 52% of wages on food. Diet costs varied 4.2-fold across all districts throughout the study period, meaning that uniform national policies to address costs and affordability would be systematically inadequate in high-cost settings and wasteful in low-cost ones. That such spatial–temporal variation exists in a small, relatively market integrated country like Rwanda suggests variation would be at least equally consequential in other low and lower-middle-income countries. High-frequency and sub-national monitoring of prices, diet costs, and affordability provides essential intelligence for policymakers to enable spatially and seasonally targeted interventions, improving both the adequacy and efficiency of food policy.
abstract_zh: 各国日益以国家推荐膳食的成本为基准，来制定食品援助和劳动法规。然而，这种基准设定基于国家年度估算，未能反映次国家级和年内成本变动，从而削弱了政策效果。利用卢旺达政府收集的月度市场价格数据（2019年4月至2024年3月），我们采用标准化膳食成本计算方法，估算了该国拟议的以食物为基础的膳食指南的成本。研究发现，在研究期间，农村地区的膳食成本通胀率高于城市地区（41%对28%），但城市地区的推荐膳食成本高出12.7%。在与坦桑尼亚接壤的边境地区，膳食成本约低6%，而与刚果民主共和国接壤的地区则高出7%。水果和蔬菜（农村和城市分别上涨110%和71%）以及淀粉类主食（分别上涨86%和83%）是成本上涨的主要贡献因素。季节性膳食成本波动也显而易见，农村和城市地区的季节性振幅分别为5.6%和6.9%，与卢旺达的农业日历同步。如果卢旺达就业人口将工资的52%用于食品支出，70%的人将无法负担推荐膳食。在整个研究期间，各地区间的膳食成本差异高达4.2倍，这意味着统一的国家政策在应对成本和可负担性问题上，在高成本地区将系统性不足，在低成本地区则造成浪费。像卢旺达这样面积小、市场相对一体化的国家尚且存在如此显著的时空差异，这表明在其他低收入和中等偏低收入国家，这种差异至少同样重要。高频次和次国家级的价格、膳食成本及可负担性监测，为政策制定者提供了关键信息，有助于实施空间和季节针对性的干预措施，从而提高食品政策的充分性和效率。

title: Investing in Agricultural Research to Sustain Growth and Competitiveness of US Agriculture
title_zh: 投资农业研究以维持美国农业的增长与竞争力
title_primary: 投资农业研究以维持美国农业的增长与竞争力
title_secondary: Investing in Agricultural Research to Sustain Growth and Competitiveness of US Agriculture
authors: Keith O. Fuglie
official: 官方在线 2026-03-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Public investments in agricultural research and development (R&D) have been a major driver of long‐term productivity growth and competitiveness of US agriculture. Public agricultural R&D has high economic returns: each $1 invested has produced about $20 in benefits to the US economy. The Federal Government provides about 70% of the funding for the agricultural R&D carried out by universities and USDA laboratories. State governments and non‐government sources provide the rest. Resources for public agricultural R&D have been declining in real terms, with annual spending down by about one‐third from its peak in 2002; the US has fallen behind other major competitor nations in spending on agricultural R&D. Part of the decline in public agricultural R&D has been offset by increased R&D by the private companies, but private R&D is concentrated on a few commodities and underinvests in the foundational science needed to sustain long‐term growth and competitiveness for US agriculture. New approaches to public–private collaboration in agricultural R&D can strengthen the financing and performance of the US agricultural innovation system.
abstract_zh: 摘要 公共农业研发投资一直是美国农业长期生产力增长和竞争力的主要驱动力。公共农业研发具有高经济回报：每投入1美元，为美国经济带来约20美元的收益。联邦政府为大学和美国农业部实验室开展的农业研发提供约70%的资金，州政府和非政府来源提供其余部分。公共农业研发资源实际价值持续下降，年度支出较2002年峰值减少约三分之一；美国在农业研发支出上已落后于其他主要竞争对手国家。公共农业研发的部分下降已被私营企业研发增加所抵消，但私营研发集中于少数几种商品，且对维持美国农业长期增长和竞争力所需的基础科学投资不足。农业研发中公私合作的新方法可以加强美国农业创新体系的融资和绩效。

title: Unveiling the Effects of Communication and Information Structure on Trust and Reciprocity: An Experiment
title_zh: 沟通与信息结构对信任和互惠影响的实验研究
title_primary: 沟通与信息结构对信任和互惠影响的实验研究
title_secondary: Unveiling the Effects of Communication and Information Structure on Trust and Reciprocity: An Experiment
authors: Yushen Li
official: 官方在线 2026-03-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We experimentally examine the effects of cheap talk communication and information structure on trust and reciprocity in an infinitely repeated favor exchange game without immediate reciprocity. Theory predicts that full trust is not incentive compatible under private information, in contrast to the public information setting. Yet, our results show that while public information yields better outcomes, subjects under private information still exhibit substantial trust and reciprocity, achieving average payoff efficiency exceeding 80% of the maximum possible. Allowing subjects to communicate freely through unrestricted text chat reinforces this outcome, whereas structured communication using pre-formulated messages has no significant effect. Content analysis suggests that free-form communication is effective in enabling subjects to develop a better understanding of one another's messages. Strategy analysis indicates that subjects predominantly adopt the strategy that achieves the socially optimal outcome, even when it is not an equilibrium under private information. This provides a strategic rationale for the observed levels of trust and reciprocity and suggests that subjects are not always beholden to incentive-compatibility. A sophisticated class of strategies explains a significant proportion of the data only under private information. This explains the lower frequency of trusting and reciprocal behaviors in this setting, as these strategies constrain such actions.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验考察了廉价交谈沟通与信息结构在无即时互惠的无限重复互惠博弈中对信任与互惠行为的影响。理论预测，在私人信息条件下，完全信任并非激励相容，这与公共信息环境形成对比。然而，我们的结果显示，尽管公共信息带来更优结果，私人信息下的受试者仍展现出显著的信任与互惠行为，平均收益效率超过最大可能值的80%。允许受试者通过无限制文本聊天自由沟通强化了这一结果，而使用预设消息的结构化沟通则无显著影响。内容分析表明，自由形式沟通有效促使受试者更好地理解彼此的信息。策略分析显示，受试者主要采用实现社会最优结果的策略，即便在私人信息下该策略并非均衡。这为观察到的信任与互惠水平提供了策略性解释，并表明受试者并非总是受制于激励相容性。一类复杂策略仅在私人信息下解释了数据的显著比例，这解释了该环境中信任与互惠行为频率较低的原因，因为这些策略限制了此类行为。

title: C'est la vie!: Mixed impacts of an edutainment television series in West Africa
title_zh: 这就是生活！：西非一部寓教于乐电视系列剧的混合影响
title_primary: 这就是生活！：西非一部寓教于乐电视系列剧的混合影响
title_secondary: C'est la vie!: Mixed impacts of an edutainment television series in West Africa
authors: Malick Dione, Jessica Heckert, Melissa Hidrobo, Agnes Le Port, Amber Peterman 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Edutainment is a promising tool for changing behavior at scale, yet little is known about how to maximize impacts. We undertake an experimental evaluation of a popular West African television series, C’est la vie!, delivered through film clubs targeted at adolescent girls and young women in rural Senegal. We examine impacts on violence against women and girls and sexual and reproductive health. Results show C’est la vie! improved knowledge on both domains three months after film clubs ended, as well as violence-related attitudes nine months later, however, had no impact on behaviors. We investigate design components intended to strengthen impacts, generally finding no additional impacts from post-screening discussions, engaging men, and podcasts. Our findings suggest that edutainment is an engaging way to reach viewers on sensitive themes, however more evidence is needed on how to effectively deliver edutainment content for sustained behavior change at scale. • Using a cluster randomized control trial, we evaluate a popular West African TV series. • We examine impacts on violence against women and girls (VAWG) and sexual and reproductive health (SRH). • We find short term knowledge gains in both domains and improved medium term VAWG attitudes. • We find no impact on behaviors. • We find no additional impacts from post-screening discussions, engaging men, and podcasts.
abstract_zh: 寓教于乐是一种有望大规模改变行为的工具，然而关于如何最大化其影响却知之甚少。我们对一部广受欢迎的西非电视连续剧《C'est la vie!》进行了实验评估，该剧通过电影俱乐部形式面向塞内加尔农村的少女和年轻女性。我们考察了其对针对妇女和女孩的暴力以及性与生殖健康的影响。结果显示，《C'est la vie!》在电影俱乐部结束三个月后改善了两个领域的知识，九个月后改善了与暴力相关的态度，但对行为没有影响。我们研究了旨在加强影响的设计要素，总体上发现映后讨论、男性参与和播客并未带来额外影响。我们的研究结果表明，寓教于乐是触及观众敏感主题的一种引人入胜的方式，但关于如何有效传递寓教于乐内容以实现大规模持续行为改变，仍需更多证据。• 通过整群随机对照试验，我们评估了一部广受欢迎的西非电视连续剧。• 我们考察了对针对妇女和女孩的暴力（VAWG）及性与生殖健康（SRH）的影响。• 我们发现两个领域的短期知识提升和中期VAWG态度的改善。• 我们发现对行为没有影响。• 我们发现映后讨论、男性参与和播客未带来额外影响。

title: Geographic Integration and Firm Exports: Evidence from China
title_zh: 地理整合与企业出口：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 地理整合与企业出口：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Geographic Integration and Firm Exports: Evidence from China
authors: Lin Tian, Yue Yu
official: 官方在线 2023-09-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the impact of transportation infrastructure, designed exclusively to enhance the integration of domestic markets, on a country’s export performance. By leveraging the expansion of China’s high-speed rail (HSR) as a quasi-natural experiment, we provide robust evidence the enhanced within-sector integration that resulted from this infrastructure development significantly boosts firms’ export performance. This impact is observed through increased export sales and volume, expanded market reach, and improved product quality. Our findings are consistent with the notion that HSR connections facilitate knowledge spillovers among exporters, which aids them in overcoming information barriers and thereby improving foreign market access. Importantly, we address potential confounding factors and demonstrate that the findings remain robust when accounting for alternative channels such as supplier and customer access and labor market pooling effects. This study underscores the pivotal role of domestic transportation infrastructure in mitigating information frictions and driving a country’s international market integration.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了专为促进国内市场一体化而设计的交通基础设施对一国出口绩效的影响。通过利用中国高铁（HSR）扩张作为准自然实验，我们提供了有力证据，表明由此类基础设施发展带来的行业内一体化显著提升了企业的出口绩效。这一影响体现在出口销售额与出口量的增长、市场覆盖范围的扩大以及产品质量的提升上。我们的研究结果与以下观点一致：高铁连接促进了出口企业间的知识溢出，帮助其克服信息壁垒，从而改善海外市场准入。重要的是，我们排除了潜在的混淆因素，并证明在考虑供应商与客户可达性以及劳动力市场集聚效应等替代渠道后，研究结论依然稳健。本研究凸显了国内交通基础设施在缓解信息摩擦、推动一国国际市场一体化中的关键作用。
